baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction li-nukhrija, its instrumental bihi, and the coordinated objects habban wa-nabatan.
baseline_models.mechanism: An agent uses an unnamed medium to move latent contents across an inside/outside boundary, jointly producing compact grain and visible plant growth.

activation_trace.role: Causing a hidden thing to emerge supplies the mediated transition from latency to visible output.
The carried seed-kernel supplies the compact first product of the emergence.
Plant growth emerging from earth supplies the expanded and visible second product.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified means causes grain and vegetation.
changed_reading.after: The clause stages agent-mediated extraction: a means activates hidden potential and brings it across a boundary as both kernel and growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-synonymous pair habban wa-nabatan after the causative verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The output contains both a portable reproductive unit and the larger life that unit can generate, so production preserves the capacity for another cycle rather than ending in consumption.

activation_trace.role: Seed-grain as a carried kernel supplies transmissible future potential.
Planting and cultivation supply the conversion of a kernel into renewed growth.
Passage from within supplies the repeated threshold crossed in each growth cycle.

changed_reading.before: Grain and vegetation are two items in a crop list.
changed_reading.after: The pair differentiates stored reproductive potential from its expanded realization, making continuity part of the output.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The live love branch of habb and the human-nurture branch of nabat remain attached to the two focus nouns.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the agricultural reading, the coordinated roots can faintly model an agency that draws out attachment and nurtures human maturation.

activation_trace.role: Love as clinging attachment supplies the relational potential carried by habb.
Human growth and nurture supply a developmental, not merely botanical, edge to nabat.
Causing what is hidden to emerge supplies the agency that makes relational potential manifest.

changed_reading.before: The objects are exclusively agricultural products.
changed_reading.after: Without replacing the crop sense, their branch range permits an exploratory echo of affection and human formation being brought into actuality.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prepared lower bed and a constructed upper domain are joined by pressure-released downward flow; the focus clause is the reversal in which that input exits the lower domain as life.

activation_trace.role: Soft, fertile earth supplies the receptive lower bed of the conversion system.
Building by joining parts supplies an organized upper structure rather than an isolated weather event.
Delivering something downward supplies the input's vertical route to the earth.
Pressure until liquid is released supplies the upstream extraction stage.
Pouring and outflow supply the released stream that reaches the lower bed.
Passage outward supplies the upward or outward response to the preceding descent.
Growth from earth supplies the system's transformed output.

structural_cues: The sequence 78:6-15 moves from prepared earth through construction above to descending, pouring water and then the focus purpose clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lower fertility, upper construction, descent, pressure-release, pouring, and emergence; I supply the directional arrow that the released upper flow enters the lower bed and returns as growth. A live alternative is that these are parallel signs without a single engineered circuit.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed medium simply causes crops.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the output stroke of a vertically organized conversion system: descent into a receptive bed is answered by life emerging from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Outward growth accumulates and folds together until it creates a newly concealing, protective garden; emergence therefore culminates in enclosure rather than permanent exposure.

activation_trace.role: A garden concealed by its trees supplies the enclosing result of the focus output.
Plants interweaving with one another supply the process by which separate shoots become canopy.
Extraction from hiding supplies the initial outward phase that the garden later reverses.
Emergent plant growth supplies the material that can thicken into an enclosure.

structural_cues: 78:16 immediately completes the focus output with gardens described as interwoven.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence followed immediately by concealed gardens and interwoven plants; I infer maturation from the focus products into that canopy. The live alternative is that 78:16 adds a separate item rather than the focus process's spatial endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Bringing forth ends when hidden plants become visible.
changed_reading.after: The emergence is one phase in a concealment cycle: exposed shoots collectively mature into a sheltering, self-concealing canopy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning draws at what is hidden, a report arrives, knowledge uncovers it, and covering blocks it; the focus's physical extraction becomes a compact model of the surah's disclosure problem.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of drawing something out gently supplies an extraction edge to the opening mutual questioning.
A report that comes and is delivered supplies the concealed content moving into public notice.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic result of extraction.
Veiling truth supplies the resistant counterforce to disclosure.
Bringing a thing out of hiding supplies the focus ayah's material enactment of disclosure.

structural_cues: The surah opens with disputed news and repeated future knowing, then closes with direct seeing and the speech of the one who covered truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, an arriving report, disclosure to knowledge, concealment of truth, and physical emergence; I infer that the crop process materializes the same hidden-to-manifest relation. The live alternative is that the epistemic frame and the creation catalogue remain rhetorically adjacent but mechanistically separate.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is evidence placed beside a dispute about news.
changed_reading.after: Its own action is evidentiary: as latent seed is made manifest in growth, disputed reality is drawn from concealment into knowability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stable supports of the growth system are later displaced and reduced to a water-like appearance, so the focus production belongs to a provisionally maintained world rather than an autonomous permanent cycle.

activation_trace.role: A gathered, elevated solidity supplies the initial stable support around the productive earth.
Solidity that halts excavation sharpens the force of the same mountains becoming removable.
Removal and displacement supply the dismantling of the earlier support.
A mirage gleaming like water supplies the reversal from solid infrastructure to insubstantial appearance.
Plant growth supplies the life temporarily sustained by the stable arrangement.

structural_cues: The mountains are fixed as pegs in 78:7 and the same mountains are moved into mirage in 78:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit stability-to-displacement reversal; I infer that the ecology nested between those poles is maintained provision rather than self-grounding nature. A live alternative is that mountain removal marks judgment without qualifying the earlier growth process.

changed_reading.before: Rain-fed growth is a recurring natural regularity.
changed_reading.after: It is a deliberately sustained interval of fertility inside a world whose supporting conditions can be withdrawn.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rest and darkness establish a covered pause before renewed activity, while an appointed time establishes delayed culmination; seed-to-growth is consequently read as timed latency rather than instantaneous production.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and rest supply a productive interval in which visible activity ceases.
Night and its darkness supply the covering under which the interval remains unseen.
Fixing a thing to a time or limit supplies delayed and bounded culmination.
The compact seed supplies potential that can remain materially present before it becomes visible growth.
Emergence across a boundary supplies the end of the latent interval.

structural_cues: Sleep, night, day, rain, and growth form one ordered sequence, and the later Day of Separation is explicitly appointed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies quiescence, darkness, seed, emergence, and an appointed limit; I supply the arrow that the first two describe a generative latency before the latter transition. The live alternative is that sleep-night rhythm and eschatological timing do not specify crop temporality.

changed_reading.before: The medium directly produces visible crops.
changed_reading.after: The purpose clause compresses a timed process: potential can remain covered and inactive-looking until its appointed emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The crop's passage from hidden potential to grouped life becomes a material analogue for people arriving in cohorts, standing in resurrection, and being set against their final wish for dust.

activation_trace.role: The coming-forth of growth or produce supplies a crop-like edge to the people's arrival.
A group of people supplies the collective human form of the later emergence.
Resurrection and rising supply the explicit human standing phase.
Earth and dust supply the terminal substrate against which renewed emergence can be imagined.
Young people arising in a group supplies a focus-root bridge from plants to human cohorts.
Passing out from within supplies the shared emergence geometry.

structural_cues: After only the garden completion in 78:16, 78:17-18 turns to the appointed Day and people arriving in groups; 78:38 names standing, and 78:40 ends at dust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crop emergence, a human-growth branch, grouped arrival, resurrection-standing, and dust; I supply the analogical arrow from vegetal emergence to embodied assembly. The live alternative is that the crop evidence proves power without encoding the later process's shape.

changed_reading.before: Crop production is one proof among the creation signs before judgment.
changed_reading.after: The focus also rehearses judgment's form: latent earthly potential is summoned outward as grouped, standing life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seed and growth move toward ripeness at an appointed time; the split-root harvest image and the matching-recompense image make judgment readable as a measured harvest of matured consequences.

activation_trace.role: A fixed appointment supplies the point at which latent development reaches decision.
The non-dominant split image of harvest time and ripeness for cutting supplies the crop-to-judgment bridge.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the consequence harvested at that point.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart supplies proportionality between growth and result.
Seed-grain supplies the initial compact input of the harvest process.
Visible growth supplies maturation between seed and harvest.
A due yield paid out in a known way supplies the focus-side image of determinate return.

structural_cues: The crop sequence is followed by an appointed Day, and both punishment in 78:26 and gift in 78:36 are named recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seed, growth, appointment, a non-dominant ripeness-for-cutting branch, recompense, and equivalence; I infer the developmental arrow from sowing to a measured harvest. The live alternative is that the split harvest branch is form-distant and should not organize the dominant recompense sense.

changed_reading.before: The crop scene and the later recompense are separate examples of power and justice.
changed_reading.after: The crop scene supplies judgment's temporal grammar: small inputs mature, reach their appointed cut, and return as proportionate outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A compact input can remain stored before multiplying into visible output; likewise acts are exhaustively counted, fixed in a record, sent ahead by hands, and finally exposed to their doer.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies preservation of every small input before its result appears.
A fixed inscription that obligates judgment supplies durable storage of the inputs.
A prior deed or advanced standing supplies what has been planted ahead of encounter.
What the two hands have earned supplies embodied agency for the stored input.
The small carried kernel supplies a material model for compact but consequential input.
Extraction from concealment supplies the later visibility of what had been stored.

structural_cues: 78:29 places exhaustive enumeration in a book, while 78:40 has each person look at what the hands sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seed, preserved enumeration, binding record, prior action, earned action, and final looking; I infer a seed-to-yield analogy for deeds becoming consequences. The live alternative is a legal ledger mechanism with no agricultural resonance.

changed_reading.before: The ayah concerns material food, while the ending concerns recorded deeds.
changed_reading.after: Grain and growth become a material demonstration that a small, hidden input can be preserved and later brought out as an enlarged visible yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus values a liquid medium by the life it brings forth; the punishment sequence reverses liquid into heat and dark outflow without cooling, while the reward sequence restores enclosed growth, fruit, and a filled cup.

activation_trace.role: Coolness opposite heat supplies the absent restorative function in the punishment scene.
Taking in liquid supplies the expected nourishing relation that is denied or corrupted.
Hot water supplies a liquid that intensifies harm instead of enabling life.
Dark seeping or outpouring supplies a degraded counterpart to the productive downpour.
An enclosed garden supplies restored, sustained vegetal life.
Grapes as vine fruit supply edible fruition beyond undifferentiated growth.
A cup filled to its top supplies abundant and beneficial liquid at the positive pole.
Growth from earth supplies the diagnostic effect of a life-giving medium.

structural_cues: The no-coolness and corrupted-drink sequence of 78:24-25 is answered by gardens, grapes, and a full cup in 78:31-34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies productive rain, absent cooling, harmful liquids, gardens, fruit, and a full cup; I infer that liquid is evaluated by whether it restores and generates life. The live alternative is a sensory pain-versus-pleasure contrast with no germination criterion.

changed_reading.before: Bihi merely identifies water as the instrument used to make crops.
changed_reading.after: The instrument is defined relationally by its fruit: true provision is liquid converted into life, while punishment is liquid severed from that generative function.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing, a split-root image of feeding and growth, and the womb branch align the focus's love and human-nurture branches into an exploratory matrix of relational generation.

activation_trace.role: A partner joined to its counterpart supplies the relational condition for generation.
The non-dominant split image of feeding and growth supplies developmental nurture within lordship language.
The womb supplies a protected site in which life develops before emergence.
Love as clinging attachment supplies the affective bond within the focus pair.
Human growth and nurture supply the developmental outcome.
Causing hidden potential to emerge supplies the transition from protected formation to manifest life.

structural_cues: Human pairing precedes the environmental sequence, while Lord and Merciful language frames the later gift and final return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, feeding-growth, womb, attachment, nurture, and emergence; I supply the cross-domain arrow from agricultural cultivation to human relational formation. The live alternative is that the love, womb, and split feeding branches are lexically live but inactive in this botanical clause.

changed_reading.before: The exploratory human-growth branches have no contextual support beyond the focus roots.
changed_reading.after: They acquire a contained echo: the crop process can also image life formed through pairing, attachment, protected nurture, and eventual emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sawaban at 78:38 activates both correctness and a rain-descending branch, allowing speech to borrow the focus's rain-to-growth mechanism. It remains valid as a branch-level analogy anchored in bihi, khuruj, and nabat, but downstream prose should say that correct speech is rendered as rain-like and fruitful, not that sawab denotes rain in this occurrence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The instrumental bihi and the emergence of habb and nabat provide a test of a descending input by what it brings forth.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending from above and settling supplies the material trajectory shared with the focus's productive input.
Correctness settling opposite error supplies the speech-side counterpart whose fruit can be tested.
Drawing hidden contents outward supplies the effect a fruitful input produces.
Visible plant growth supplies the concrete image of beneficial fruit.

changed_reading.before: The focus rain process and permitted correct speech are unrelated domains.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus provides a material criterion for speech: what lands correctly is like rain that discloses its rightness by bringing life forth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the same turab root spans age-peers and final dust, while the kafir cue carries a seed-covering branch and the focus nabat carries young people arising in a group. The loop remains anchored through focus seed and growth, but downstream prose must present it as a contrast among branch images, not equate companions with dust or claim that kafir means farmer here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Habb as seed-kernel, nabat as grouped young growth, and nukhrija as emergence make the focus a bridge between substrate, cohort, and outcome.

activation_trace.role: Equality in age and companionship supplies a cohort of lives at a common stage.
Covering seed supplies the productive form of concealment against which truth-covering can be contrasted.
Dust and earth supply the wished-for substrate where the final speaker would stop.
The seed-kernel supplies latent life that can be covered without being annihilated.
Young people arising in a group supply the human-cohort edge of growth.
Emergence from within supplies the transition that prevents buried potential from remaining mere dust.

changed_reading.before: Seed, equal-age companions, the final truth-coverer, and dust are separate images.
changed_reading.after: The focus makes a strange loop visible: common earth can conceal seed, seed can emerge as a living cohort, while the final wish seeks substrate without the emergence that made the surah's abundance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant narrow-aperture branch mapped from sama and joins it to the sky becoming open doors. It remains spatially anchored in nukhrija's passage outward and the preceding descent, but downstream prose should call it an aperture analogy enabled by a split root, not a lexical explanation of al-sama.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Nukhrija names passage outward, while bihi marks an input whose prior route can be read as complementary ingress.

activation_trace.role: An opened closure and widened entrance supply the cosmic-scale threshold.
The split-root image of a narrow aperture through which something enters supplies the ingress side of the mechanism.
An entrance supplies the explicit plurality of passages in the opened sky.
Passage from within supplies the complementary egress through the earth-life boundary.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes growth without emphasizing the boundary architecture around it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, growth is one transit in an ingress-egress world: input passes down through an upper aperture and transformed life passes outward through a lower one.

strongest_changes: The immediate context converts the focus from an isolated crop statement into the outward stroke of a vertical pressure, descent, earth, and emergence system.
The next ayah reverses simple disclosure: growth brought out of hiding matures into an interwoven garden that hides and shelters again.
The whole-surah frame lets botanical emergence model both disputed reality becoming knowable and embodied life arriving for the appointed Day.
Split-root harvest imagery, record imagery, and what hands send ahead turn seed-to-growth into a contained model of matured and proportionate consequence.
The mountains' stability-to-mirage reversal recasts fertility as provision maintained within a contingent world.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's three roots form an unusually productive latent mechanism: hidden kernel, caused emergence, and expanded growth. Whole-surah cues repeatedly reuse that mechanism across hydraulics, concealment, knowledge, resurrection, accounting, nurture, and even constrained speech, while non-dominant mapped branches expose several live but explicitly contained cross-domain readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus-only baseline cannot identify bihi's antecedent; the water identification belongs to the context reconstruction.
The resurrection, deed-yield, and nurture models depend on analogy across domains rather than direct referential identity.
The harvest, nurture, sky-aperture, and opening-question activations rely on non-dominant split-root branches and should remain qualified.
The punishment-and-reward liquid contrast may be primarily sensory rather than a deliberate contrast in generative function.
